How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (8)

  1. How many full-time employees does ModelOp have, and how many work in engineering and customer support?
    Headcount indicates capacity to support a large bank deployment.
  2. What is the total equity capital ModelOp has raised to date, by round?
    Total capital raised helps a bank judge the vendor's staying power.
  3. Has ModelOp reduced headcount in the last 24 months, and by how much?
    Layoffs at a small vendor can reduce support and product capacity.
  4. Is ModelOp a party to any pending or recently concluded litigation, and what is its nature?
    Material litigation can threaten a small vendor's finances and focus.
  5. Has ModelOp had any security incident affecting its systems or customer data in the last five years, and how was each disclosed?
    A bank needs the vendor's incident record to assess how it handles security events.
  6. Has ModelOp lost any named reference customer in the last three years, and why?
    Loss of reference customers can signal product or service problems.
  7. Have there been any disputes, investigations or unplanned departures involving ModelOp's executives or directors?
    Leadership disputes or misconduct at a small vendor can quickly affect delivery.
  8. What is the pricing metric for ModelOp Center (per model, per use case, per user or flat licence), and what are typical annual costs for a deployment of our size?
    Without list pricing a bank cannot benchmark a quote.
